typography.rtl_specifics: For Urdu text, increase line-height by one step (e.g., use leading-loose) as Arabic script requires more vertical clearance. Ensure text alignment uses 'text-start' and 'text-end' rather than 'text-left' or 'text-right'. Never center-align dense data.
typography.instruction: Avoid Inter. Use Chivo for sharp, authoritative English headings. Ensure both font families are imported properly.

colors.rules: Avoid generic SaaS blue. Use high-contrast monochrome (Midnight Slate) for structure and primary actions. Action items use Primary (#0F172A). Use Accent Success for Profit/Valuation and Accent Destructive for stock-outs/expenses. Neutral greys must have a slight blue tint (Slate). NEVER use #1B93A4 (Teal).

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized for data visibility. Use h-full on children.
layouts.surfaces: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), max rounded-sm or rounded-none. No default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.
layouts.rtl_architecture: Root element must toggle dir='ltr' and dir='rtl'. ALL spacing MUST use Tailwind logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, border-s-, border-e-). The sidebar will naturally shift to the right in RTL mode when using flex/grid properly.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar for core modules (Dashboard, Vehicles, Parts, Customers, Finance, Settings). Top Sticky Header for Language Toggle (En/Ur), User Profile, and Quick Actions. Header must use Crystal Glass (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200).

visual_enhancers.login_screen: Use the provided automotive engine bay image as a full-screen background with a bg-black/70 overlay to ensure the login card (white, sharp edges) pops intensely.
visual_enhancers.data_density: Use compact tables (p-2 cells) for Inventory and Vehicles. Strip zebra striping in favor of clean 1px bottom borders.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on all rows, active scaling on buttons (active:scale-95). Staggered entrance animations for dashboard metrics.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. In RTL mode, icons conveying direction (arrows, chevrons) must be flipped using 'rtl:rotate-180'.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). High contrast (bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800).
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular styles. Avoid excessive rounded corners. Focus on data visibility.
components.data_tables: Use Shadcn Table. Must include sticky headers for scrolling. Align numbers to the 'end', text to the 'start'.
components.forms: Shadcn Form/Input. One-action dismantle workflow should be a multi-step modal or dedicated focused page without distractions.
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Monochrome palettes (shades of slate) with single accent colors for highlighting specific metrics (e.g., this month vs last).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No light gray text on white. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.rtl_a11y: Ensure icons conveying direction (arrows, chevrons) are flipped in RTL (using rotate-180 based on dir attribute). Icons like search or camera do not flip.
accessibility.testing_tags: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='dismantle-vehicle-action').

image_urls.description: Gray engine bay. Apply bg-black/70 overlay for stark contrast.
Collection of car exhaust catalytic converters. Use as a fallback for spare parts without photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: Files are .js (JSX), NOT .tsx. Generate React components using standard JavaScript/JSX syntax.
Prioritize RTL layout setup first. Default language on first load is Urdu (RTL). Toggle to English (LTR) must be seamless.
Use standard Tailwind with logical properties (`ps-`, `pe-`, `ms-`, `me-`). NEVER hardcode `ml-`, `pr-`, `left-`, or `right-` for layout structures.
Implement JWT Auth system (Email/Password). Build Dynamic Role-Based Access Control (Owner, Manager, Accountant) configured in Settings.
Build the core 'Vehicles' and 'Spare Parts' inventory systems sharing a unified DB logic for tracing costs.
For the 'Dismantle' workflow: Create a unified 'One-Action Workflow' converting a vehicle to multiple parts while retaining cost traceability and vehicle history.
Accounting & Finance: Include Customers, Expenses, Payroll, and automated P&L generation. Japanese Yen (JPY) is the default currency with a 10% default tax rate.
Invoicing: Use invoice prefix 'MTC-'. Implement a print-friendly invoice view.
Do not use generic blue gradients. Stick to the 'Swiss Brutalist/High Contrast' palette: deep slates, stark whites, sharp borders.
Implement `data-testid` on all buttons, form inputs, and navigation links.
Use Shadcn UI (JS versions) for all forms, tables, and dropdowns. Customize Shadcn spacing to be dense (tight paddings) to fit more data on the screen.
NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Always use solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + bg opacity).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Ensure hover states explicitly set text colors to avoid readability loss.
